meta.refreshNote: Darshan fees, booking windows and ID requirements are re-verified against official portals on a recurring schedule. Everything else (stay, hotels, transport, nearby temples) is static research data.

entries.label: Sarvadarshanam (free darshan)
entries.windowNote: No booking — join the general queue at Tirumala.
entries.idRequired: None for the general queue, though carrying a photo ID is wise.

entries.label: ₹300 Special Entry Darshan
entries.windowNote: Released 90 days ahead · max 6 people per booking · non-transferable.
entries.idRequired: Aadhaar is mandatory (Voter ID, Driving Licence or Passport also accepted) — every pilgrim's ID must match the booking exactly.

entries.label: VIP Break Darshan (Srivani Trust)
entries.windowNote: Requires a Srivani Trust donation first, then a separate slot booking.
entries.idRequired: Same Aadhaar/photo ID used for the Srivani Trust donation and booking.

official.label: TTD accommodation — Srinivasam and other Nivas guest houses
official.note: Booked on the same TTD portal. Budget to mid-range, inside Tirumala itself.
official.distance: TTD runs both on-hill cottages at Tirumala itself (walking distance to the temple) and Srinivasam in Tirupati town, ~22–25 km away with frequent connecting buses — which one you get depends on availability.

airport.name: Tirupati Airport (TIR)
airport.distance: ~15 km from Tirupati town, ~35 km from Tirumala hill

transport.lastMile: TTD runs frequent free/paid buses from Tirupati up to Tirumala (about every 2 minutes); paid APSRTC buses and private cabs also run the ghat road. Autos work within Tirupati town but aren't used on the hill road.

nearby.name: Sri Padmavathi Ammavari Temple, Tiruchanur
nearby.note: Goddess Padmavathi's temple — Lord Venkateswara's consort; many pilgrims visit both in one trip

nearby.name: Sri Kalahasti Temple
nearby.note: A Pancha Bhuta Sthalam (Vayu/wind lingam), a major Shiva shrine

entries.label: Yatra Parchi — RFID registration (mandatory)
entries.windowNote: Rolling registration, no fixed release date — but register at least 2–3 weeks ahead. The portal can pause temporarily during extreme rush.
entries.idRequired: Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving Licence or Passport — carry the same ID used at registration when collecting your RFID card.

official.label: Shrine Board Bhawans & Niharika
official.note: Book via the Shrine Board site. Dorm-style to simple private rooms along the trek route and at Katra base camp.
official.distance: Niharika and the other base-camp bhawans are in Katra, ~13 km from the shrine itself; smaller Shrine Board bhawans also sit directly along the trek route (Adhkuwari, Sanjichhat) for pilgrims breaking the climb.

railway.name: Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Katra Railway Station (SVDK)
railway.distance: Right in Katra — the yatra starts a short walk from here

transport.lastMile: From Katra, the shrine is a ~13 km trek — on foot, by pony/mule, palki (palanquin), or helicopter from Sanjichhat (book separately, weather-dependent).

nearby.name: Baba Dhansar
nearby.note: Shiva shrine with a natural waterfall and cave

nearby.name: Shiv Khori
nearby.note: Natural cave shrine of Lord Shiva, a popular full-day add-on

entries.label: Paid / VIP Darshan & Aarti
entries.idRequired: Government photo ID (Aadhaar, Passport, Voter ID or Driving Licence) — the name must match your booking exactly.

official.label: Bhakt Niwas (Sansthan accommodation)
official.note: Booked 60 days ahead on the same portal. Max 4 people per room, 48-hour stay limit.
official.distance: ~1.3 km from the temple (New Bhakt Niwas) — a short auto ride or 15–20 minute walk.

transport.lastMile: Autos from the station run roughly ₹100 (small auto, 4–5 people) to ₹150 (larger shared auto); cabs are also easy to find.

nearby.name: Shani Shingnapur
nearby.note: Famous open, door-less temple to Shani Dev

entries.label: Char Dham Yatra registration (mandatory)
entries.windowNote: Opens a few months before the season (route open roughly late April to early November). Register as soon as it opens, and try the portal at 5–8am or 10–11pm — midday traffic causes frequent failures.
entries.idRequired: Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN, Passport or Driving Licence uploaded at registration; children can use Aadhaar, a school ID or birth certificate at offline counters.

official.label: GMVN guest houses
official.note: Government-run budget to mid-range rooms along the Char Dham route; Kedarnath itself also has basic trust-run rooms near the shrine.
official.distance: GMVN's Kedarnath camps are ~0.5–2 km from the temple, right at the end of the trek.

transport.lastMile: The road ends at Sonprayag/Gaurikund; from there it's a ~16–18 km trek, pony, palki or helicopter (from Phata/Sersi/Guptkashi) to the temple.

nearby.name: Tungnath (Panch Kedar)
nearby.distance: ~88 km by road + a 4 km trek (via Gaurikund–Sonprayag–Chopta)
nearby.note: The world's highest Shiva temple, part of the Panch Kedar circuit

entries.label: Char Dham Yatra registration (mandatory)
entries.windowNote: Opens a few months before the season (route open roughly late April to early November). Register as soon as it opens, and try the portal at 5–8am or 10–11pm — midday traffic causes frequent failures.
entries.idRequired: Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN, Passport or Driving Licence uploaded at registration; children can use Aadhaar, a school ID or birth certificate at offline counters.

official.label: GMVN guest houses
official.note: Government-run budget to mid-range rooms; Badrinath town also has private hotels and dharamshalas near the temple.
official.distance: ~700 m from the temple — an easy walk.

transport.lastMile: Badrinath is motorable all the way via Joshimath — shared taxis and buses run right to the temple; no trek required for the main shrine.

nearby.name: Mana Village
nearby.note: India's last village before the Tibet border — Vyas Gufa and Bhim Pul are close by

entries.label: Char Dham Yatra registration (mandatory)
entries.windowNote: Opens a few months before the season (route open roughly late April to early November). Register as soon as it opens, and try the portal at 5–8am or 10–11pm — midday traffic causes frequent failures.
entries.idRequired: Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN, Passport or Driving Licence uploaded at registration; children can use Aadhaar, a school ID or birth certificate at offline counters.

official.label: GMVN guest houses
official.note: Government-run budget rooms along the route; limited private options directly in Gangotri.
official.distance: Right by the temple — around 30–40 m away.

transport.lastMile: Gangotri is motorable all the way via Uttarkashi — shared taxis and buses run right to the temple; no trek required for the main shrine.

nearby.name: Gaumukh
nearby.note: The source glacier of the Bhagirathi/Ganga river

entries.label: Char Dham Yatra registration (mandatory)
entries.windowNote: Opens a few months before the season (route open roughly late April to early November). Register as soon as it opens, and try the portal at 5–8am or 10–11pm — midday traffic causes frequent failures.
entries.idRequired: Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN, Passport or Driving Licence uploaded at registration; children can use Aadhaar, a school ID or birth certificate at offline counters.

official.label: GMVN guest houses
official.note: Government-run budget rooms near Janki Chatti, a short trek from the shrine.
official.distance: At Janki Chatti, the roadhead — about 5–6 km short of the shrine itself (see the trek note below).

transport.lastMile: The road ends at Janki Chatti; from there it's a ~5–6 km trek, pony or palki to the shrine.

nearby.name: Surya Kund
nearby.note: A hot spring where pilgrims cook rice as prasad

entries.label: Sugam Darshan (queue-less)
entries.idRequired: Government photo ID entered at booking (Aadhaar, Passport, etc.) — must match what you present at entry.

stay.note: No single official dharamshala portal found — many choultries and dharamshalas operate near Vishwanath Gali on a walk-in or phone basis. Hotels are widely available across Varanasi.

transport.lastMile: Autos, e-rickshaws and cycle-rickshaws run from the station; vehicles can't go right up to Vishwanath Gali, so expect a short walk for the last stretch.

nearby.name: Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple
nearby.note: Popular Hanuman shrine, founded by Tulsidas

nearby.name: Durga Temple (Durga Kund)
nearby.note: Also called the Monkey Temple

nearby.name: New Vishwanath Temple, BHU
nearby.note: A modern replica built by the Birla family

entries.label: Darshan (open 24 hours)
entries.windowNote: No booking needed — open to all, every day, 24 hours.

official.label: SGPC Sarai (pilgrim inns)
official.note: Free to nominal-cost rooms run by SGPC. Minimum 2 people per booking, max 2 nights — book a few days ahead around festivals.
official.distance: Inside the Golden Temple's own sarai complex — effectively on-site, a short walk from the sanctum.

airport.name: Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport (ATQ)

transport.lastMile: Autos, e-rickshaws and cabs run throughout Amritsar; the Golden Temple's own plazas handle the final stretch on foot.

nearby.name: Durgiana Temple
nearby.note: A Hindu temple built in a similar style to the Golden Temple

entries.label: General Darshan
entries.linkLabel: Shri Ram Janmbhoomi Teerth Kshetra portal

entries.label: Sugam Darshan pass
entries.windowNote: Free, but book as soon as your dates are fixed — footfall is extremely high (23+ crore visitors in 2025).
entries.linkLabel: Shri Ram Janmbhoomi Teerth Kshetra portal
entries.idRequired: Government photo ID declared at booking (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving Licence or Passport) — the physical copy is mandatory for entry.

stay.note: No single official accommodation portal found — the Trust and UP Tourism list dharamshalas; roughly 50 new hotels were opening through 2025 to meet demand.

transport.lastMile: Autos, e-rickshaws and cabs run from both the airport and station into central Ayodhya.

nearby.name: Hanuman Garhi
nearby.note: Hilltop Hanuman temple — most pilgrims visit this first

nearby.name: Kanak Bhawan
nearby.note: Temple to Ram and Sita, known for its ornate interiors

nearby.name: Nageshwarnath Temple
nearby.note: Ancient Shiva temple linked to Kush, son of Lord Ram

entries.label: General Darshan
entries.windowNote: No online booking system found as of this research. Temple opens 5am — arrive early morning or evening to avoid the longest queues. Note: entry is restricted to Hindus; non-Hindu visitors can view the temple from the Meghanad Pacheri boundary wall. Check SJTA's official channels for any future booking system.
entries.idRequired: None required for entry, though it is restricted to Hindus (see note above).

stay.note: Numerous mutths and dharamshalas near the temple, mostly walk-in. Hotels widely available along Puri's beach road.

transport.lastMile: Autos and cycle-rickshaws run from the station into the temple area.

nearby.name: Konark Sun Temple
nearby.note: UNESCO World Heritage Sun Temple

nearby.name: Lingaraj Temple, Bhubaneswar
nearby.note: One of Odisha's oldest and largest Shiva temples

entries.label: General Darshan
entries.windowNote: No online booking system found — managed by Tamil Nadu HR&CE, general queue-based entry.

stay.note: Choultries and dharamshalas near the temple on a walk-in basis. Hotels available across Rameswaram town.

railway.name: Rameswaram Railway Station (RMM)
railway.distance: Right in town, ~1–2 km from the temple

transport.lastMile: Autos and cabs run from the station; Madurai airport taxis also run the full route directly to Rameswaram.

nearby.name: Kothandaramaswamy Temple
nearby.note: The only structure left standing after the 1964 cyclone

nearby.name: Dhanushkodi
nearby.note: Ghost town at the island's tip, with ruined temple remains

entries.label: General Darshan
entries.windowNote: No centralized online booking portal identified in this research — general queue-based entry. Check the Dwarkadhish Temple Trust or Gujarat Tourism closer to your date.

stay.note: Dharamshalas run by various trusts near the temple. Hotels available across Dwarka town.

transport.lastMile: Autos and cabs run from the station; both airports have taxi counters for the longer run into Dwarka.

nearby.name: Nageshwar Jyotirlinga
nearby.note: One of the 12 Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva

nearby.name: Rukmini Devi Temple
nearby.note: Dedicated to Lord Krishna's chief queen

nearby.name: Bet Dwarka
nearby.note: Island believed to be Krishna's original residence
